title: End Dates and Final Status of Withholding Elections and Deduction Orders
content:
Under Benefit Withholding and Deduction Orders, an election or order ends in one of four ways, each recording as its end date the last payment date it applied to.

## Clauses

1. A voluntary election whose claim closes or is withdrawn is terminated, with end date the last payment issued on that claim.
2. An amount-limited order is terminated when the amount deducted to date under it (all deductions taken over its life, less any refunded) reaches its certified amount, with end date the payment date of the deduction that completed it.
3. An order ended by the issuing agency is terminated, with end date the last payment issued before the kind's termination lead business days ran out.
4. A voluntary election stopped by the claimant is revoked, with end date the last payment issued before the kind's revocation lead business days ran out; a revocation confirmed before the election took effect leaves no payment affected.
5. A terminated or revoked holding is never reactivated: a later deduction needs a new election or a new order.

## The four endings side by side

| How it ends | Holding | Final status | End date recorded |
|---|---|---|---|
| Claim closes or is withdrawn | Voluntary election | Terminated | Last payment issued on that claim |
| Certified amount reached | Amount-limited order | Terminated | Payment date of the deduction that completed the certified amount |
| Ended by the issuing agency | Agency order | Terminated | Last payment issued before the termination lead ran out |
| Stopped by the claimant | Voluntary election | Revoked | Last payment issued before the revocation lead ran out |

## Hypothetical cases

*Dates and amounts below are invented for illustration.*

- **Claim closure.** A federal income tax election stands on a claim whose last payment is issued on a Friday; the claim then closes. The election is terminated with that Friday as its end date.
- **Certified amount completed.** An order with a certified amount of $600.00 has $575.00 deducted to date; a deduction of $25.00 on a payment dated the 14th of a month brings the total to $600.00. The order is terminated with end date the 14th.
- **Agency termination.** The issuing agency's termination notice is received, and payments are issued both before and after the termination lead runs out. The end date is the last of the payments issued before the lead ran out.
- **Revocation before effect.** A claimant confirms stopping a state income tax election while it is still requested and has not reached its effective date. The election is revoked and no payment is affected by it.
- **After the end.** A claimant whose federal election was revoked wants withholding again. The revoked election is not reactivated; withholding needs a new election.
